description:
KChess is a free, open-source chess app for your Mac. Play the engine or play online, solve puzzles, drill endgames and review every game in one fast, native window.

PLAY
• Stockfish is built in, from a gentle beginner to full strength.
• Connect your Lichess accounts and play rated games with real clocks.
• Follow players, see who is online, and watch their live games, Lichess TV and broadcasts.

TRAIN
• Rated puzzles in every theme, plus the daily puzzle.
• Storm, Streak and Rush from a local puzzle database, so they work offline.
• Endgame drills against the engine, from positions checked to be won or drawn.
• Board vision: coordinates, square colours and knight paths.
• An opening trainer with notes on your repertoire.

REVIEW
• Engine lines, a full game review, the Masters and Player explorers, and opening names.
• Studies that keep every variation, comment and annotation. Import and export PGN.
• Insights: your ratings, results and openings, and your score against anyone.

MORE
• Move by voice: say "knight f3" or "castle kingside". Speech is recognised on your Mac.
• Lichess boards, 11 piece sets, 22 colour themes, and your own themes.
• Keyboard first: ⌘K goes anywhere and starts any game.
• Export positions and games as PGN, PNG or animated GIF.

YOURS
No KChess account and no KChess server. Your games live on your Mac, Lichess sign-ins are encrypted with a key in your Keychain, and Settings shows every request the app makes.

KChess is open source under the GPL-3.0-or-later; its source code and that of the bundled Stockfish engine are on GitHub. KChess is not affiliated with Lichess or Stockfish.
promotionalText: Play the engine or play online, solve puzzles that work offline, and review every game. Free and open source.
